calls.statement:
SELECT f.sale_date, d.day_name, d.is_trading_day, count(*) AS lines, sum(quantity) AS units, min(etl_loaded_at) AS first_load, max(etl_loaded_at) AS last_load
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
WHERE s.store_id=102 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1

WITH s AS (
 SELECT p.sku, p.product_name, sum(f.quantity) AS units,
  sum(CASE WHEN NOT coalesce(f.staff_purchase_flag,false) THEN f.quantity ELSE 0 END) AS units_ex_staff
 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
 WHERE st.store_id=102 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'
 GROUP BY 1,2),
r AS (
 SELECT p.sku, sum(r.quantity_returned) AS ret
 FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
 WHERE st.store_id=102 AND r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'
 GROUP BY 1)
SELECT s.sku, s.product_name, s.units, s.units_ex_staff, coalesce(r.ret,0) AS returned, s.units-coalesce(r.ret,0) AS net_units
FROM s LEFT JOIN r USING (sku) ORDER BY units DESC LIMIT 8
